description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Batch / multicall / delegatecall-loop executors where a per-call accounting invariant (balanceOf / totalSupply / supply-cap / credit / debt) can be bypassed or broken across a sequence of sub-calls. Seed: Size Credit M-01 (Multicall.multicall validates the borrow-aToken cap with balanceOf(this) instead of totalSupply()). Two-signal gate (batch-executor signal AND accounting-invariant signal) + thin-wrapper / pure-view / admin-setter suppression. Mirrors the liquidation_health_accounting research-prototype convention.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: batch-executor signal (name OR call/delegatecall loop) AND accounting-invariant signal (supply/cap/credit/debt terms)
fp_controls.pure_view_aggregate_suppression: staticcall/view-only aggregate with no mutation and no invariant terms -> suppressed
fp_controls.admin_setter_suppression: batch of setX()/config setters with no balanceOf/totalSupply read and no before/after capture -> suppressed
fp_controls.thin_wrapper_suppression: name-gated multicall with no call-loop, no delegatecall, and no invariant terms (delegates to a library) -> suppressed
fp_controls.non_executing_loop_suppression: a for/while loop that does not execute a call/delegatecall is not a batch executor
fp_controls.encode_decode_lib_suppression: libraries that only abi.encode/decode calls (no execution) -> suppressed
fp_controls.unresolved_mutator_demotion: batch over opaque external targets (.call to non-self) or a validate in an unresolved helper with no local before/after -> needs_context (not high)
